title: Hand of Straights
summary: Use every card exactly once to form groups of groupSize cards.

contractDetails.constraints: 1–10000 cards with values in [0,1000000000]. 1 ≤ groupSize ≤ number of cards.

statement: Use every card exactly once to form groups of groupSize cards. Each group must contain consecutive values, with one occurrence of each value in that group. Decide whether this is possible.

examples.explanation: Both 2s need a 3, but only one is available.
Each card forms its own group.

constraints: 1–10000 cards with values in [0,1000000000]. 1 ≤ groupSize ≤ number of cards.
hints: Conceptual: Card copies are separate resources.
Directional: The smallest unused card must begin a group.
Implementation: Visit possible starts in sorted order and subtract one copy of each required consecutive card for every group you start.
complexityAnalysis: Expected O(n log n) time and O(n) extra space with sorting and hashed frequencies.
